# Qwen2 numerical fixtures

Tiny synthetic, seeded Qwen2 weights generated by
`scripts/hf_profile_fixtures.py` with Transformers 4.57.1, Torch 2.8.0 and
Safetensors 0.6.2. These are randomly initialized test parameters, not
downloaded pretrained weights. Biases are deliberately nonzero; the BF16
case has a separate output head. Reference logits and every KV row are bound
to the weight file by SHA-256 and checked with absolute tolerance `2e-5`.

The same generator creates the untied Llama F32 case in `hf-llama`.
